Ground Truth: Order management functionality serves as the central hub for operational data in the store.
Operational data managed in order management includes orders, payments, shipment processing, inventory updates, and return requests.
The 'Orders' chapter provides information on managing customer orders.
The 'Shipping management' chapter covers the processes related to shipping orders.
The 'Requests for quote (RFQ)' chapter details how to handle customer requests for quotes.
The 'Return requests' chapter explains the process for managing product returns.

Area: Order management - Shopping carts and wishlists
Ground Truth: The 'Shopping carts and wishlists' chapter discusses the management of customer shopping carts and wishlists.
The 'Inventory management' chapter provides guidance on managing store inventory.
The 'Checkout attributes' chapter outlines the settings related to the checkout process.
The 'Order settings' chapter details the configuration options available for order management.
To define order settings, go to Configuration → Settings → Order settings.
The Order settings window enables multi-store configuration.
The 'Checkout disabled' setting disables the checkout process.
The 'Anonymous checkout allowed' setting enables customers to purchase products without registration.
The 'Use one page checkout' setting allows customers to buy a product or service on a single webpage.
The 'Order totals on payment info tab' setting displays a product list and order totals in the payment info tab.
Customers may be required to accept the 'Terms of service' before processing the order on the shopping cart page.
Customers may be required to accept the 'Terms of service' before processing the order on the confirm order page.
The 'Disable Billing address step' setting pre-fills the billing address using default registration data.
The 'Disable Order completed page' setting redirects customers to the order details page after an order is placed.
The 'Display Pickup in store' setting shows the pickup option on the shipping method or shipping address page.
The 'Min order sub-total amount' setting prevents orders below a specified amount from being issued.
The 'Calculate Min order sub-total amount including tax' setting includes tax in the subtotal calculation.
The 'Min order total amount' setting prevents orders below a specified total amount from being issued.
The 'Auto update order totals' setting automatically updates order totals when editing an order in the admin area.
The 'Order ID counter' setting allows orders to start with a specified number.
The 'Order number mask' setting allows the creation of a custom order number format.
The 'Is re-order allowed' setting enables customers to re-order previous items.
The 'Complete order when delivered' setting marks an order as complete only when its shipping status is delivered.
The 'Export orders with products' setting allows exporting of orders along with their products.
The 'Allow admins to buy Call for price products' setting enables administrators to purchase products marked as 'Call for price'.
The 'Show product thumbnail in order details page' setting displays product thumbnails in the order details.
The 'Attach PDF invoice' setting can be configured for various order status emails.
The 'Activate gift cards after completing of an order' setting activates related gift cards upon order completion.
The 'Deactivate gift cards after cancelling of an order' setting deactivates related gift cards when an order is canceled.
The 'Deactivate gift cards after deleting of an order' setting deactivates related gift cards when an order is deleted.
The 'Delete gift card usage history after order cancellation' setting removes gift card usage history after an order is canceled.
Return request settings can be configured in the Return request settings panel.
The RFQ functionality allows customers to submit a Request for Quote for products in their shopping cart.
The RFQ feature is useful for negotiating bulk discounts or special pricing.
The RFQ plugin can be enabled or disabled with a single setting.
Access Control List (ACL) permissions can be configured for both the storefront and admin panel.
A new button appears on the shopping cart page if the RFQ plugin is active and permitted by ACLs.
Users can edit their RFQ request before submitting it.
Once submitted, the RFQ can no longer be edited by the user.
Users can manage their RFQs and Quotes from their account section after submission.
Users receive an email notification when a new quote is sent.
Users can create an order from an acceptable quote that is not expired.
Once a cart is generated from a quote, it enters 'quote mode' and cannot be modified.
Users can exit quote mode to return to the main store page.
Store owners receive an email notification when a user submits an RFQ.
Admins can view and manage RFQs and Quotes from the admin panel.
Admins can modify, delete, or cancel an RFQ from the RFQ list.
Admins can create a quote directly from an RFQ.
Admins can edit a quote by modifying product data and setting an expiration date.
A quote remains hidden from the user until the admin sends it.
Once a quote is sent, it cannot be edited by the administrator.
A sent quote can only be deleted if the user has not created an order from it.
Store owners can view all existing shopping carts and wishlists of customers on one page by accessing Sales → Shopping carts and wishlists.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Shopping Cart
Ground Truth: Selecting 'Shopping cart' from the Shopping cart type dropdown and clicking 'Search' displays a list of all products placed in carts but not purchased.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Shopping Cart
Ground Truth: The 'Remove' button in the shopping cart allows customers to remove an item from the cart.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Shopping Cart
Ground Truth: The 'Qty.' button allows customers to change a product's quantity in the shopping cart.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Shopping Cart
Ground Truth: The 'Continue shopping' button allows customers to proceed to the catalog from the shopping cart.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Shopping Cart
Ground Truth: The 'Estimate shipping' button allows customers to estimate shipping costs by entering their shipping address.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Shopping Cart
Ground Truth: Shipping estimation can be disabled by clearing the 'Estimate shipping enabled (cart page)' checkbox in the Shipping settings.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Shopping Cart
Ground Truth: The 'Gift wrapping' dropdown is a checkout attribute that can be managed in the Checkout attributes chapter.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Shopping Cart
Ground Truth: Customers can enter a discount code in the shopping cart, which can be disabled by clearing the 'Show discount box' checkbox in the Shopping cart settings.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Shopping Cart
Ground Truth: Customers can use gift cards in the shopping cart, which can be disabled by clearing the 'Show gift card box' checkbox in the Shopping cart settings.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Shopping Cart
Ground Truth: The shopping cart totals section displays the shipping fee, tax info, reward points earned, and terms of service.
Selecting 'Wishlist' from the Shopping cart type dropdown and clicking 'Search' displays the customer's wishlists.
A wishlist is a list of products that customers can share or save for later.
The 'Add to wishlist' button appears on the product details page if adding to wishlist is enabled for that product.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Multiple Wishlist
Ground Truth: Registered customers can create and manage multiple wishlists, with one default wishlist that cannot be renamed or deleted.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Multiple Wishlist
Ground Truth: The default wishlist is named 'Wishlist' and is permanent.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Multiple Wishlist
Ground Truth: Registered users can create custom wishlists that can be named, managed, and deleted.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Multiple Wishlist
Ground Truth: When adding a product to a wishlist, if no custom wishlists exist, it is added to the default 'Wishlist'.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Multiple Wishlist
Ground Truth: If at least one custom wishlist exists, products are added to the default wishlist and users are prompted to move them to a custom wishlist.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Multiple Wishlist
Ground Truth: Users can move products between wishlists using a dropdown menu on the Wishlist page.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Shopping Cart and Wishlist Settings
Ground Truth: Shopping cart and wishlist settings can be changed in the Configuration → Settings → Shopping cart settings page.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Common Settings
Ground Truth: Common settings include options to show discount and gift card boxes, allow cart item editing, and set maximum shopping cart items.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Mini Shopping Cart Settings
Ground Truth: Mini shopping cart settings include options to show the mini shopping cart and define the number of products displayed.

Area: Shopping Carts And Wishlists - Wishlist Settings
Ground Truth: Wishlist settings include maximum wishlist items, allowing customers to email their wishlist, and enabling multiple wishlists.
To search for shipments, go to Sales → Shipments.
The top area of the shipment list page allows searching by start date, end date, tracking number, warehouse, country, state/province, county/region, and city.
The 'Load not delivered' checkbox excludes already delivered items from the shipment list.
The 'Load not shipped' checkbox excludes already shipped items from the shipment list.
The 'Load not ready for pickup' checkbox includes only items that are not ready for pickup.
Store owners can set selected shipments as shipped, delivered, or ready for pickup.
Store owners can print packaging slips for selected or all shipments.
Clicking 'View' opens the shipment details window.

In the shipment details window, users can set a tracking number, add an admin comment, view shipment total weight, mark the shipment as shipped or delivered, edit shipment dates, print packaging slips, and delete the shipment.
If 'Pick up in store' is selected, the shipment can be marked as ready for pickup.
Shipping can be set up in the Configure shipping section.
Inventory management is a system of stock level control in nopCommerce.
To set up inventory, go to Catalog → Products → Edit a product.
There are three inventory methods: Don't track inventory, Track inventory, and Track inventory by product attributes.
Store owners can choose the Don't track inventory option for products that do not require inventory tracking.

Area: Inventory Management - Don't Track Inventory Settings
Ground Truth: When not tracking inventory, store owners can define a Warehouse for shipping rates.

Area: Inventory Management - Don't Track Inventory Settings
Ground Truth: Store owners can set a Minimum cart qty to restrict the quantity allowed in a customer's shopping cart.

Area: Inventory Management - Don't Track Inventory Settings
Ground Truth: Store owners can set a Maximum cart qty to limit the quantity allowed in a customer's shopping cart.

Area: Inventory Management - Don't Track Inventory Settings
Ground Truth: Store owners can enter a comma-separated list of Allowed quantities for the product.

Area: Inventory Management - Don't Track Inventory Settings
Ground Truth: Store owners can select the Not returnable checkbox to indicate that the product is not returnable.
Store owners can select Track inventory to monitor stock levels for products without variants.
The Stock quantity field indicates the total quantity of the product, which decreases when an order is shipped.
Store owners can manage warehouses for shipping rates under Configuration → Shipping → Warehouses.
Store owners can select the Multiple warehouses checkbox to manage inventory from multiple warehouses.
The Reserved qty field indicates the quantity ordered but not yet shipped.
The Planned qty field indicates the quantity added to a shipment but not yet shipped.
Store owners can select the Display availability checkbox to show stock availability in the public store.
Store owners can select the Display stock quantity checkbox to show the stock quantity on the product details page.
The Minimum stock qty field sets a threshold for stock levels.
Store owners can choose an action from the Low stock activity dropdown list when stock falls below the minimum stock quantity.
Store owners can set Backorders to allow purchases when stock is unavailable.
The Allow back in stock subscriptions option enables customers to subscribe for notifications about product availability.

Area: Inventory Management - Track Inventory by Product Attributes
Ground Truth: Store owners can select Track inventory by product attributes to manage stock for various product attribute combinations.

Area: Inventory Management - Track Inventory by Product Attributes Settings
Ground Truth: Store owners can choose the Warehouse for shipping rates under Configuration → Shipping → Warehouses.

Area: Inventory Management - Track Inventory by Product Attributes Settings
Ground Truth: Store owners can select the Display availability checkbox to show stock availability in the public store.

Area: Inventory Management - Track Inventory by Product Attributes Settings
Ground Truth: Store owners can select the Display stock quantity checkbox to show the stock quantity on the product details page.

Area: Inventory Management - Track Inventory by Product Attributes Settings
Ground Truth: Store owners can set a Product availability range to display when the product is not available.

Area: Inventory Management - Track Inventory by Product Attributes Settings
Ground Truth: Store owners can set Minimum cart qty and Maximum cart qty for products with attributes.

Area: Inventory Management - Track Inventory by Product Attributes Settings
Ground Truth: Store owners can enter a comma-separated list of Allowed quantities for products with attributes.

Area: Inventory Management - Track Inventory by Product Attributes Settings
Ground Truth: Store owners can select Allow only existing attribute combinations to restrict purchases to available stock.

Area: Inventory Management - Stock Quantity for Attribute Combinations
Ground Truth: To set Stock quantity for different attribute combinations, go to the Attribute combinations tab of the Product attributes panel.
Store owners can view a low stock report under Reports → Low stock.
The return request feature enables customers to request a return on items previously purchased.
Return requests are only available for completed orders.
Return requests settings are managed in Configuration → Settings → Order settings in the Return request settings panel.
To enable return requests, the 'Enable returns system' checkbox must be selected.
When enabled, a 'Return item(s)' button is displayed for completed orders on the order details page.

Area: Return Requests - Submit a Return Request
Ground Truth: Customers can submit a return request by going to the My account window and clicking Orders.

Area: Return Requests - Submit a Return Request
Ground Truth: Customers can select the quantity to return using the Qty to return dropdown list.

Area: Return Requests - Submit a Return Request
Ground Truth: Customers can select a return reason from the Return reason dropdown list.

Area: Return Requests - Submit a Return Request
Ground Truth: Customers can select a return action from the Return action dropdown list.

Area: Return Requests - Submit a Return Request
Ground Truth: Customers can upload additional documents or pictures if the Allow file uploads checkbox is selected.

Area: Return Requests - Submit a Return Request
Ground Truth: Customers can enter optional comments in the Comments field when submitting a return request.
Store owners can manage return requests in the administration area under Sales → Return requests.
Store administrators can view and edit return request details.
Store administrators can select the return request status from a predefined list.
Store administrators can edit the reason for return and requested action if necessary.
Return request settings can be defined in Configuration → Settings → Order settings.
The return request number mask can be specified in the Return request settings panel.
The number of days that the return request is available can be set in the Return request settings panel.
A list of reasons for return can be managed in the Return request reasons panel.
A list of actions for return requests can be managed in the Return request actions panel.
Checkout attributes represent additional order information gathered during the final stage of the shopping process.
Shop owners can specify whether a bought product requires gift wrapping or careful handling using checkout attributes.
Checkout attributes are displayed on the shopping cart page and can be selected by users before checkout.
To set up or edit checkout attributes, navigate to Catalog → Attributes → Checkout attributes.
To create a new checkout attribute, click 'Add new' to open the 'Add a new checkout attribute' window.
The 'Add a new checkout attribute' page is available in advanced and basic modes.
The 'Attribute info' panel requires defining the attribute name and text prompt.
The 'Control type' dropdown allows selection of display methods such as Dropdown list, Radio button list, Checkboxes, or Textbox.
Textbox and Date picker control types do not require predefined values, while Dropdown lists and others do.
Selecting the 'Required' checkbox makes the attribute value selection mandatory before purchase completion.
The 'Shippable product required' checkbox displays the attribute only for products that need to be shipped.
The 'Tax exempt' checkbox indicates that no tax will be applied to the checkout attribute.
If tax is applied, the tax category for the checkout attribute must be selected from the dropdown list.
'Limited to stores' allows restricting the attribute to specific stores.
To use store limitation, the setting 'Ignore limit per store rules (sitewide)' must be disabled.
Clicking 'Save and continue edit' proceeds to the 'Attribute values' panel.
In the 'Attribute values' panel, clicking 'Add a new checkout attribute value' creates a new attribute value.
The 'Add a new checkout attribute value' window requires defining the attribute value name.
The 'Price adjustment' adds an amount to the total purchase sum if the attribute value is selected.
The 'Weight adjustment' changes the order weight by the entered amount if the attribute value is selected.
The 'Pre-selected' checkbox indicates that the attribute value is preselected for the customer.
In the 'Condition' panel, a store owner can specify conditions for the checkout attribute's visibility.
Clicking 'Save' displays the new attribute on the shopping cart page in the public store.
To view and manage orders, go to Sales → Orders.
The orders page lists all current orders.
A new order appears on the orders page after a customer completes a transaction.

Store owners can search for orders using various criteria including start date, end date, warehouse, product name, order statuses, payment statuses, shipping statuses, store, vendor, billing phone number, billing email address, billing last name, billing country, payment method, order notes, and order number.
Orders can be exported to an external file by clicking the Export button.
Orders can be imported from Excel by clicking the Import button and selecting a file.
Imported orders are distinguished by order GUID, and existing orders will be updated if the order GUID already exists.
It is not recommended to import more than 500 - 1,000 records at once due to memory resource requirements.
Clicking View beside an order displays the full order information.
The Invoice (PDF) button generates an invoice for the order in PDF format.
The order status is only Completed when the payment status is Paid and the shipping status is Delivered.
Store owners can manually change the order status using the Change status button.
Store owners can cancel an order, which requires confirmation.
The Edit credit card button is visible when the Manual Credit Card payment method is used.
The payment status can be Pending, Authorized, Paid (captured), Refunded, Partially refunded, or Voided.
If the payment status is Authorized, the Void and Capture buttons are available.
If the payment status is Pending, the Mark as paid button can be clicked.
If the payment status is Paid, the Refund and Partial refund buttons are available.
Store owners can view and edit billing and shipping information.
Store owners can create several shipments per order.
The shipping status changes to Partially shipped if not all products are shipped.
The shipping status changes to Shipped once all products are shipped.
The shipping status changes to Delivered once all shipments are delivered.
Store owners can view product information including price, quantity, and total price.
Store owners can edit the product's price, quantity, discount, and total.
Store owners can delete a product from the system.
Store owners can add a product to an order by selecting it from a list.
Store owners can view, delete, and add notes to an order.
